SWEDEN.desc: High Secular-Rational, High Self-Expression. Values autonomy, tolerance, weak religion.

JAPAN.desc: High Secular-Rational, Moderate Survival. Values secularism but emphasizes group conformity and order.

BRAZIL.desc: Moderate Traditional, Moderate Self-Expression. Values religion/tradition but also expressiveness and joy.

EGYPT.desc: High Traditional, High Survival. Values security, religion, group loyalty, and family stability.

USA.desc: Moderate Traditional, High Self-Expression. Unique mix of religious values and strong individualism.

CHINA.desc: High Secular-Rational, High Survival. Values pragmatism, security, and state/group stability.
